metadata.name: edict_seals
metadata.description: Edict Seal: a Metaplex Core membership NFT whose mint buys and burns $EDICT, with an equal-share pot (ARCHITECTURE section 4, docs/validation/P2-01_SEAL_DESIGN.md).

instructions.name: apply_price_change
docs: Anyone, after the eta: applies the queued price change to the tiers above the one being minted.

instructions.name: apply_rule_set
docs: Anyone, after the eta: writes the queued allow list to the collection's Royalties plugin.

instructions.name: cancel_seal
docs: Admin, only before the opening: cancels the Seal and sends the free pot to the fixed buyback wallet.

instructions.name: claim_vault
docs: The current owner of a Seal: claims its accumulator share and, once, its genesis share.

accounts.name: owner
docs: The current owner of the Seal asset: signs and receives.

instructions.name: finalize_genesis
docs: Anyone, 24 hours after the opening: shares genesis among the eligible Seals minted so far.

instructions.name: forfeit_burned
docs: Anyone, for a Seal whose Core asset was burned: returns its unclaimed shares to the pot as income and removes it from
the active set (owner decision 2026-11-09).

accounts.name: asset
docs: the handler. Its address ties it to the `Seal` record by the seeds below: only an asset the program minted has one.

instructions.name: init_collection
docs: Upgrade authority, once: creates the Core collection with the Royalties plugin (500 bps, pot 60 / Treasury 40).

accounts.name: authority
docs: The upgrade authority of this program. Pays the collection's rent.

accounts.name: collection
docs: The new collection: a fresh keypair that signs the transaction.

instructions.name: init_config
docs: Upgrade authority: creates `Config`, `State`, `Pending` and funds the pot vault; verifies every pinned account.

accounts.name: authority
docs: The upgrade authority of this program. Pays the rent of the accounts and of the pot vault.

accounts.name: pot
docs: The Seal pot vault: a system-owned PDA with no data, funded here to its rent minimum.

accounts.name: treasury
docs: exist yet, never a program account (review R5). Its key must equal the `treasury` argument.

instructions.name: mint_reserve
docs: The owner wallet: mints 1 to 5 team Seals to the Treasury, free. The first call opens the mint.

accounts.name: signer
docs: The owner wallet: pays the rents of the Seals and signs.

accounts.name: pot
docs: The pot vault (read for the genesis amount and the sync).

instructions.name: mint_seal_cpmm
docs: Anyone: the public mint on $EDICT's CPMM pool (after the migration).

accounts.name: swapper_edict
docs: The swapper's associated $EDICT account, pinned in Config at init.

accounts.name: swapper_wsol
docs: The swapper's associated wSOL account (created idempotently by the client in the same transaction).

accounts.name: asset
docs: The new Seal asset: a fresh keypair that signs the transaction.

instructions.name: mint_seal_curve
docs: Anyone: the public mint on $EDICT's LaunchLab curve (before the graduation).

accounts.name: swapper
docs: LaunchLab's `buy_exact_in` declares its payer `mut` (Anchor ConstraintMut 2000 otherwise, docs/validation/SEALS_VENUE.md).

accounts.name: swapper_edict
docs: The swapper's associated $EDICT account, pinned in Config at init.

accounts.name: swapper_wsol
docs: The swapper's associated wSOL account (created idempotently by the client in the same transaction).

accounts.name: asset
docs: The new Seal asset: a fresh keypair that signs the transaction.

instructions.name: queue_price_change
docs: Admin: queues a new base and factor behind the 24 hour timelock.

instructions.name: queue_rule_set
docs: Admin: queues a new royalty allow list (the System Program required) behind the timelock.

instructions.name: set_art
docs: Admin, before the opening: the metadata folder and the art manifest hash.

instructions.name: set_paused
docs: Admin: stops or resumes PUBLIC mints (claims and cranks keep working).

instructions.name: set_team_numbers
docs: Admin, once, before the opening: the 30 team numbers.

instructions.name: sweep_to_buyback
docs: Anyone, after a cancel: sends what the pot holds above its rent minimum to the buyback wallet.

instructions.name: sync_pot
docs: Anyone: realizes the pot's free income for the Seals that exist.

instructions.name: vault_withdraw_core
docs: The current owner: moves a Core prize out of the Seal's vault.

instructions.name: vault_withdraw_token
docs: The current owner: moves tokens out of the Seal's vault.

errors.name: NotTeamNumber

errors.name: ArtNotSet

errors.name: InvalidUri

errors.name: ZeroAmount

errors.name: NothingReceived

errors.name: NothingSpent

errors.name: Overspent

errors.name: BurnMismatch

errors.name: BurnOutOfBounds

errors.name: InvalidFactor

errors.name: NothingQueued

errors.name: AlreadyQueued

errors.name: TimelockActive

errors.name: InvalidRuleSet

errors.name: NothingToClaim

errors.name: AlreadyForfeited

types.name: Config
docs: `Config`: the singleton `["config"]`. Written by `init_config`, `init_collection` and the admin instructions.

fields.name: admin
docs: Squads vault on mainnet. Admin instructions and nothing else; it can never move a holder's money.

fields.name: reserve_signer
docs: The owner wallet: the only signer of `mint_reserve`. Fixed at init.

fields.name: reserve_recipient
docs: The Treasury: the owner of every team Seal. Fixed at init.

fields.name: treasury
docs: Receives 40% of a mint's payment and 40% of every royalty. Fixed at init.

fields.name: buyback_wallet
docs: The only destination of a cancel. Fixed at init.

fields.name: swapper_edict_ata
docs: The swapper PDA's associated $EDICT and wSOL accounts, computed once at init (P2-00: a key compare per mint).

fields.name: launchlab_program
docs: Raydium LaunchLab: the program and every account of `buy_exact_in` on $EDICT's pool, read from the pool or derived
at init.

fields.name: cpmm_program
docs: Raydium CPMM: the program and the graduated pool of $EDICT, DERIVED at init from the CPMM config the platform names
(the pool exists only after the migration; a mint on it also requires the LaunchLab pool to say "migrated").

fields.name: collection
docs: The Core collection (the default key until `init_collection`).

fields.name: art_hash
docs: sha256 of the art manifest, published with the metadata. Not checkable on chain.

fields.name: base_uri
docs: The metadata folder URI; the program builds `base_uri + NNN + ".json"` (three digits, as the files are named).

fields.name: team_mask
docs: The 30 team numbers: bit `number - 1`.

fields.name: payment_lamports
docs: The fixed payment of a public mint (G-NFT-PRICE): 60% to the pot, 40% to the Treasury.

fields.name: burn_by_tier
docs: The burn amount of tiers 0 to 2 (derived from the base and the factor, floor at every step).

fields.name: trigger
docs: 0 = the 100th public mint, 1 = `finalize_genesis` after 24 hours, 2 = the first public mint after the 24 hours.

fields.name: uri
docs: The collection's own metadata URI.

fields.name: rules
docs: The royalty allow list: the System Program plus the verified marketplaces (design D3), at most 8.

fields.name: admin
docs: Squads vault on mainnet.

fields.name: reserve_signer
docs: The owner wallet, the only signer of `mint_reserve`.

fields.name: reserve_recipient
docs: The Treasury, the owner of every team Seal.

fields.name: treasury
docs: The Treasury, the payee of 40% of the payment and the 40% royalty creator.

fields.name: launchlab_program
docs: Raydium LaunchLab and CPMM of this cluster (they differ between mainnet and devnet).

fields.name: payment_lamports
docs: The fixed payment of a public mint (G-NFT-PRICE), 60% pot / 40% Treasury.

types.name: Pending
docs: `Pending`: the singleton `["pending"]`: the queued price change, the queued rule set, a proposed admin.

fields.name: pending_admin
docs: The default key when no rotation is proposed.

fields.name: realized
docs: Income realized now, all credited through the accumulator.

fields.name: active
docs: The divisor of this sync: the Seals that share income (minted minus forfeited).

types.name: PublicMintsOpened
docs: The 30th team Seal exists: public mints are possible and the 24 hour genesis window starts (review R3).

types.name: Seal
docs: `Seal`: one per Seal, `["seal", asset]`.

fields.name: number
docs: 1 to 250: its art.

fields.name: seq
docs: The mint sequence, 1 to 250 in the order minted (team first).

fields.name: forfeited
docs: Set by `forfeit_burned`: the Core asset was burned and the Seal left the active set.

fields.name: acc_snapshot
docs: The accumulator value at the mint, advanced by every claim (the fraction is kept).

types.name: SealForfeited
docs: A burned Seal left the active set (`forfeit_burned`).

fields.name: released_acc
docs: The unclaimed accumulator share returned to the pot as income, in lamports (rounded down; the exact amount is scaled).

fields.name: released_genesis
docs: The unclaimed genesis share returned to the pot as income, in lamports.

fields.name: active
docs: The Seals that share income from now on.

fields.name: burn_lamports
docs: The burn amount of the tier, in SOL lamports, the buyer offered to the swap.

fields.name: wsol_spent
docs: What the venue actually took (a partial fill takes less).

fields.name: received
docs: $EDICT units received (balance difference), all burned.

fields.name: refunded_lamports
docs: Lamports of the wSOL account closed to the buyer (the unspent part of a partial fill plus the account rent).

fields.name: venue
docs: 0 = LaunchLab curve, 1 = CPMM pool.

types.name: State
docs: `State`: the singleton `["state"]`. Written by every mint, claim and crank.

fields.name: minted
docs: The supply and sequence counter: every Seal ever minted, burned or not (at most 250). The number of a burned Seal
stays set in `minted_mask`, so it can never be minted again.

fields.name: active
docs: The Seals that share income: `minted` minus the forfeited (burned) ones. The divisor `n` of the accumulator.

fields.name: next_public
docs: The lowest candidate for the next public number.

fields.name: opened_at
docs: 0 until the first `mint_reserve`: the art is locked and the genesis amount is locked at this moment.

fields.name: public_open_at
docs: 0 until the 30th team Seal exists: public mints are possible from this moment and the 24 hour genesis window
starts here (review R3: a team batch that takes longer than 24 hours must not let a finalize precede every public mint).

fields.name: minted_mask
docs: The numbers that exist: bit `number - 1`.

fields.name: acc_per_seal
docs: The reward-per-Seal accumulator, lamports x 10^12.

fields.name: owed_scaled
docs: Accumulator shares credited and not yet paid, lamports x 10^12 (exact; the reserve is its ceiling).

fields.name: genesis_locked
docs: The amount locked at the opening, apart from the regular pot, until it is shared.

fields.name: genesis_owed
docs: The shares created at the sharing and not yet paid.

fields.name: genesis_eligible_count
docs: Seals eligible for genesis: 30 team plus public mints 1 to 100 minted before the sharing.

fields.name: kind
docs: 0 = token, 1 = Core asset.

fields.name: item
docs: The mint (token) or the prize asset (Core).
